observation: ChangesetStore.get bound durable document id to storage identity but did not enforce the published taowind-code.changeset.v0.3 protocol. Unknown durable protocols could therefore reach ordinary read consumers even though apply and rollback failed closed.
changes: Enforce CHANGESET_PROTOCOL in ChangesetStore.get after durable id verification.
Extend the existing changeset protocol regression to cover direct get(), apply(), and rollback() consumers.
Keep apply/rollback protocol checks as defense in depth; no new architecture or product policy selected.

verification.source_contract_replay: PASS: direct get now routes through verifiedChangesetProtocol; apply and rollback still route through the same invariant.
verification.focused_regression_contract: PASS BY INSPECTION: 3 focused cases encode direct read, apply, and rollback protocol drift; unknown v9 must throw UNSUPPORTED_CHANGESET_PROTOCOL before side effects.
verification.hosted_runtime: HTTP 502 transient upstream error from Developer Execution Runtime; not claimed as passed.
verification.github_actions: Must remain untriggered; commits use [skip ci] [skip actions].
